# 🌆 Evening News Podcast (Basic English 850 Words Edition)

欢迎阅读今天的晚报！所有的英文正文均严格限制在 Basic English 850 核心词汇内（专有名词除外），这是专为你生成的深度晚报演示版。

**Good evening. This is your news for the day.**
*晚上好。这是今天的资讯。*

**We will start with the strong shaking of the earth in the Philippines. A great moving of the earth, with a measure of 7.8, caused the fall of many high buildings and houses in the south of the country. At least 32 persons met their death, and many more are without their homes tonight. At first, the government put out a danger sign for a great sea wave, but they took it away after some hours. The people living there are full of fear, but helpers are working through the night to give food and water.**
*我们先从菲律宾强烈的地震（地球震动）开始。一场震级为7.8级的强烈地震（地球大运动）导致了该国南部许多高楼和房屋的倒塌。至少有32人遇难，今晚还有更多人无家可归。起初，政府发出了巨大海浪（海啸）的危险警告信号，但在几个小时后取消了。住在那里的人们充满了恐惧，但是救援人员（帮助者）正在彻夜工作以提供食物和水。*

**In other news, China's Xi Jinping makes a journey to North Korea to see Kim Jong Un. This is an important political move because such a journey is not common. They had a long talk about working together and giving support to one another. The United States and other countries are looking at this meeting with great care, as it may change the balance of power in that part of the world.**
*在其他新闻方面，中国国家主席习近平前往朝鲜会见金正恩。这是一个重要的政治举动，因为这样的访问并不常见。他们就如何共同合作和相互支持进行了长谈。美国和其他国家正在非常谨慎地关注这次会面，因为它可能会改变世界那个地区的力量平衡。*

**Finally, in Armenia, the government leader Nikol Pashinyan says he had a great win in the political selection of a new government. This selection was seen by many as a test of Russia's power over the country. Pashinyan wants to move his country closer to the West. Even with strong pressure from Russia, the people of Armenia gave their support to his new direction.**
*最后，在亚美尼亚，政府领导人（总理）尼科尔·帕希尼扬表示，他在新政府的政治选举（政治挑选）中取得了巨大胜利。这次选举被许多人视为对俄罗斯对该国影响力的考验。帕希尼扬希望他的国家向西方靠拢。即使在俄罗斯的强大压力下，亚美尼亚人民仍然对他的新方向给予了支持。*

**This comes to the end of our evening news. Have a good rest, and we will see you tomorrow.**
*我们的晚间新闻到此结束。好好休息，我们明天见。*

item.description:
## 晚间新闻播客：科技创新、经济脉动与世界风云 (Evening News Podcast: Tech Innovation, Economic Pulse, and World Events)

欢迎收听我们的晚间新闻播客，在这里，我们将用简单易懂的英语和中文，为您解读今日头条。

---

### 📖 Key Vocabulary (核心词汇)

1. **Keynote** /ˈkiːnoʊt/ (n.) - 主旨演讲，主要发言。
* [English] The Apple WWDC keynote event showed many new things.
* [Chinese] 苹果全球开发者大会的主旨演讲展示了许多新事物。
2. **Debut** /ˈdeɪbjuː/ (n.) - 首次亮相，首次登场。
* [English] OpenAI plans its stock market debut soon.
* [Chinese] OpenAI计划很快在股票市场首次亮相。
3. **Masses** /ˈmæsɪz/ (n.) - 大众，普通民众。
* [English] The new Rivian R2 car is for the masses, not just a few rich people.
* [Chinese] 新款Rivian R2汽车是面向大众的，而不仅仅是少数富人。
4. **Deploy** /dɪˈplɔɪ/ (v.) - 部署，调动。
* [English] JPMorgan Chase plans to deploy more smart computer power.
* [Chinese] 摩根大通计划部署更多智能计算能力。
5. **Evacuation** /ɪˌvækjuˈeɪʃən/ (n.) - 疏散，撤离。
* [English] The military gave an evacuation order for the city.
* [Chinese] 军队发布了该城市的疏散命令。

---

### 🎯 Grammar Focus (语法焦点)

1. **Simple Present Tense for News Reporting (一般现在时用于新闻报道)**
* News often uses the simple present tense to state facts, current events, or ongoing situations, making the information feel immediate and relevant.
* **Example from script:** "[Aria] Apple, a very big company, **had** a special meeting. It **was** called WWDC 2026. ... The big news **is** about iOS 27. This **is** the new brain for your iPhone."
* **Explanation:** While the meeting "had" and "was called" in the past, the "big news is" and "this is" iOS 27 are presented as current facts or ongoing relevance. This mix is common in news to connect past events to their present implications.

2. **Using "To Be" for Definitions and Descriptions (使用“是”进行定义和描述)**
* In simple English, the verb "to be" (is, are, was, were) is frequently used to define terms, describe states, or identify subjects, which is crucial for ESL learners to grasp new concepts.
* **Example from script:** "[Andrew] This meeting **is** a big day for Apple. It **is** a time when they show new ideas. ... Siri **is** the voice helper in your Apple phone."
* **Explanation:** This structure helps to clearly introduce and explain what something is, making complex topics more accessible.

---

### 📝 Full Bilingual Script (完整双语脚本)

[Aria] Good evening. Welcome to our English learning news. I am Aria.
[Aria] 晚上好。欢迎收听我们的英语学习新闻。我是Aria。

[Andrew] And I am Andrew. We are here to help you learn English. We will talk about the day's big news. We will use simple words. This will help you understand well.
[Andrew] 我是Andrew。我们在这里帮助您学习英语。我们将讨论今天的大新闻。我们会使用简单的词语。这将帮助您更好地理解。

[Aria] That is right, Andrew. Today, we have many important stories. We will talk about new phones, big money plans, and world events.
[Aria] 没错，Andrew。今天，我们有许多重要的故事。我们将谈论新手机、大笔资金计划和世界事件。

[Andrew] We will make sure to give you a clear picture. We will give you the facts. We will give you the story behind the news.
[Andrew] 我们会确保给您一个清晰的画面。我们会提供事实。我们会告诉您新闻背后的故事。

[Aria] Let us start with some news from the world of machines and smart tools. Apple, a very big company, had a special meeting. It was called WWDC 2026.
[Aria] 让我们从机器和智能工具世界的一些新闻开始。苹果公司，一家非常大的公司，举行了一次特别会议。它被称为WWDC 2026。

[Andrew] Yes, Aria. This meeting is a big day for Apple. It is a time when they show new ideas. They show new things for their phones and computers. It is for people who make apps.
[Andrew] 是的，Aria。这次会议对苹果来说是重要的一天。这是他们展示新想法的时候。他们展示了手机和电脑的新功能。这是为那些制作应用程序的人准备的。

[Aria] The big news was about iOS 27. This is the new brain for your iPhone. It makes your phone work. It makes it do many things.
[Aria] 大新闻是关于iOS 27。这是您iPhone的新大脑。它让您的手机工作。它让手机做很多事情。

[Andrew] Think of iOS as the mind of your phone. The new iOS 27 has many new parts. It will make your phone faster. It will make it easier to use. It will give you new ways to do things.
[Andrew] 把iOS想象成您手机的大脑。新的iOS 27有许多新部分。它将使您的手机更快。它将使它更容易使用。它将为您提供做事情的新方法。

[Aria] One very big part of this news is about Siri. Siri is the voice helper in your Apple phone. You talk to Siri. Siri helps you.
[Aaria] 这条新闻中一个非常重要的部分是关于Siri。Siri是您苹果手机里的语音助手。您和Siri说话。Siri帮助您。

[Andrew] Apple says this new Siri is much smarter. It uses a kind of smart computer power. We call this AI. This AI helps Siri understand what you say. It helps Siri do more for you.
[Andrew] 苹果说这个新的Siri聪明多了。它使用一种智能计算机能力。我们称之为AI。这个AI帮助Siri理解您说的话。它帮助Siri为您做更多事情。

[Aria] For example, Siri can now do more complex things. It can help you plan your day better. It can help you find things on your phone faster. It can even write small notes for you.
[Aria] 例如，Siri现在可以做更复杂的事情。它可以帮助您更好地规划您的一天。它可以帮助您更快地在手机上找到东西。它甚至可以为您写小笔记。

[Andrew] This is a big step for Apple. They want Siri to be a true helper. A helper that is always there. A helper that learns from you.
[Andrew] 这是苹果的一大步。他们希望Siri成为一个真正的助手。一个总是在那里的助手。一个向您学习的助手。

[Aria] But there is a point to note. This new, smart Siri will not be in Europe at first. This is a big story by itself.
[Aria] 但有一点需要注意。这个新的、智能的Siri最初不会在欧洲推出。这本身就是一个大新闻。

[Andrew] That is right, Aria. Some countries in Europe have new rules. These rules are for very big companies. They want to make sure all companies play fair. They want to make sure no one company has too much power.
[Andrew] 没错，Aria。欧洲的一些国家有新规定。这些规定是针对非常大的公司。他们想确保所有公司都公平竞争。他们想确保没有一家公司拥有过多的权力。

[Aria] These rules are called "Digital Markets Act." They want to make sure that big companies open their systems. They want to make sure small companies can also grow.
[Aria] 这些规定被称为“数字市场法案”。他们想确保大公司开放他们的系统。他们想确保小公司也能成长。

[Andrew] So, Apple needs more time. They need to make sure their new Siri works with these rules. It is a big work. They need to change some parts of Siri for Europe.
[Andrew] 所以，苹果需要更多时间。他们需要确保他们的新Siri符合这些规定。这是一项大工程。他们需要为欧洲改变Siri的一些部分。

[Aria] This shows that new rules can make things slow. But the idea is to make things good for all people. It is about fair play in the market.
[Aria] 这表明新规定可能会让事情变慢。但其目的是为了让所有人都受益。这是关于市场上的公平竞争。

[Andrew] Another new thing from Apple is about "Liquid Glass." This is a way that things look on your screen. It makes the pictures clear. It makes the colors good.
[Andrew] 苹果的另一个新功能是关于“液态玻璃”。这是一种让屏幕上显示内容的方式。它使图片清晰。它使颜色良好。

[Aria] Apple is making Liquid Glass better. They want your screen to look even more real. They want the colors to be very true. This is good for watching videos or looking at pictures.
[Aria] 苹果正在改进液态玻璃。他们希望您的屏幕看起来更真实。他们希望颜色非常逼真。这对于观看视频或查看图片很有好处。

[Andrew] They also talked about how your Mac computer will look. The Mac will have a better look. It will be more pleasing to the eye. This is a small change, but it makes a big difference for many people.
[Andrew] 他们还谈到了您的Mac电脑的外观。Mac将拥有更好的外观。它会更赏心悦目。这是一个小小的改变，但对许多人来说意义重大。

[Aria] And there are hints about a new kind of iPhone. A phone that can fold. Yes, a phone that bends in the middle.
[Aria] 而且还有关于一种新型iPhone的暗示。一种可以折叠的手机。是的，一种中间可以弯曲的手机。

[Andrew] This is a very big idea. Most phones are flat. But a foldable phone can be small when shut. Then it can be big when open. Like a small book.
[Andrew] 这是一个非常大的想法。大多数手机都是平的。但可折叠手机在合上时可以很小。然后打开时可以很大。就像一本小书。

[Aria] The new iOS 27 has words in its code. These words show that Apple is working on this. They are making plans for a phone that can change its size.
[Aria] 新的iOS 27在其代码中包含了一些词语。这些词语表明苹果正在为此努力。他们正在为一种可以改变大小的手机制定计划。

[Andrew] This means that in the future, we may see an iPhone that folds. It is a big step for phone making. It could change how we use our phones every day.
[Andrew] 这意味着将来，我们可能会看到一款可折叠的iPhone。这是手机制造的一大步。它可能会改变我们每天使用手机的方式。

[Aria] So, Apple is making many new things. They are making phones smarter. They are making screens better. And they are thinking about the future of phones.
[Aria] 所以，苹果正在制造许多新事物。他们正在让手机更智能。他们正在让屏幕更好。他们正在思考手机的未来。

[Andrew] It is a time of much change in the world of machines. And Apple is at the front of this change.
[Andrew] 这是机器世界发生巨大变化的时代。而苹果正走在这场变化的前沿。

[Aria] Now, let us move to the world of money and business. OpenAI, a company that makes smart computer power, plans to sell parts of its company to the public.
[Aria] 现在，让我们转向金钱和商业世界。OpenAI，一家制造智能计算机能力的公司，计划向公众出售其公司的一部分。

[Andrew] This is called a "stock market debut." It means that for the first time, many people can buy a small part of OpenAI. This is a big step for any company.
[Andrew] 这被称为“股票市场首次亮相”。这意味着许多人第一次可以购买OpenAI的一小部分。这对任何公司来说都是一大步。

[Aria] OpenAI is famous for making ChatGPT. This is a smart computer program. It can talk to you. It can write things for you. It can help you learn.
[Aria] OpenAI因制造ChatGPT而闻名。这是一个智能计算机程序。它可以和您交谈。它可以为您写东西。它可以帮助您学习。

[Andrew] This plan means OpenAI will get much money. They will use this money to make their smart computer power even better. They will make new ideas.
[Andrew] 这个计划意味着OpenAI将获得大量资金。他们将利用这笔资金使他们的智能计算机能力变得更好。他们将创造新的想法。

[Aria] This also starts a new race. Another company, Anthropic, is also making smart computer power. They are like OpenAI.
[Aria] 这也开启了一场新的竞争。另一家公司Anthropic也在制造智能计算机能力。他们和OpenAI很像。

[Andrew] So, we will see two big companies working hard. They will try to make the best smart computer power. This is good for all of us. It means more new things will come.
[Andrew] 所以，我们将看到两家大公司努力工作。他们将努力制造最好的智能计算机能力。这对我们所有人都有好处。这意味着将会有更多新事物出现。

[Aria] Speaking of money, a man named Jim Cramer talks about the stock market. He gives ideas about what to watch.
[Aria] 说到钱，一位名叫Jim Cramer的男士谈论股票市场。他给出了一些值得关注的建议。

[Andrew] Jim Cramer is a well-known person. He talks about money on TV. He tells people what he thinks about companies.
[Andrew] Jim Cramer是一位知名人士。他在电视上谈论金钱。他告诉人们他对公司的看法。

[Aria] He gave his top 10 things to watch for the stock market today. This helps people who put their money in companies.
[Aria] 他给出了今天股票市场最值得关注的10件事。这有助于那些将钱投入公司的人。

[Andrew] One big thing he talked about was SpaceX. This is a company that sends rockets to space. It is owned by Elon Musk.
[Andrew] 他谈论的一件大事是SpaceX。这是一家将火箭送入太空的公司。它由Elon Musk拥有。

[Aria] SpaceX also plans to sell parts of its company to the public. This is a very big event. Many people want to buy parts of SpaceX.
[Aria] SpaceX也计划向公众出售其公司的一部分。这是一个非常大的事件。许多人想购买SpaceX的股份。

[Andrew] SpaceX has big plans. They want to send people to Mars. They want to make space travel common. So, many people think this company will grow very big.
[Andrew] SpaceX有宏伟的计划。他们想把人送到火星。他们想让太空旅行变得普遍。所以，许多人认为这家公司会发展得非常大。

[Aria] But some people say the price for parts of SpaceX is too high. They say it is not a safe place for money. It is a risk.
[Aria] 但有些人说SpaceX的股份价格太高了。他们说这不是一个安全的投资地点。它有风险。

[Andrew] This is always the way with new, big companies. There is much hope. There is also some risk. People must think hard before they put their money in.
[Andrew] 新兴的大公司总是这样。有很大的希望。也有一些风险。人们在投资之前必须仔细考虑。

[Aria] Let us talk about cars now. Rivian, a company that makes electric cars, has a new car. It is called the R2.
[Aria] 现在让我们谈谈汽车。Rivian，一家制造电动汽车的公司，推出了一款新车。它被称为R2。

[Andrew] This R2 car is important. Rivian wants it to be a car for many people. Not just for a few. It will be a car that more people can buy.
[Andrew] 这款R2汽车很重要。Rivian希望它成为一款面向大众的汽车。不仅仅是少数人。它将是一款更多人能买得起的汽车。

[Aria] Electric cars are good for the earth. They do not use gas. They do not make bad air. So, more electric cars are a good thing.
[Aria] 电动汽车对地球有好处。它们不使用汽油。它们不产生污染空气。所以，更多的电动汽车是件好事。

[Andrew] Rivian wants to be like Tesla. Tesla is a very big electric car company. Rivian wants to make many cars. They want many people to know their name.
[Andrew] Rivian想成为像特斯拉一样的公司。特斯拉是一家非常大的电动汽车公司。Rivian想制造很多汽车。他们想让很多人知道他们的名字。

[Aria] The R2 is a smaller car than their other cars. It will also be less money. This makes it possible for more people to buy it.
[Aria] R2比他们其他的车小。它的价格也会更低。这使得更多人有可能购买它。

[Andrew] This is a good sign for electric cars. It means they are becoming more common. They are becoming a choice for many families.
[Andrew] 这对电动汽车来说是一个好兆头。这意味着它们正变得越来越普遍。它们正成为许多家庭的选择。

[Aria] And in the world of banks, JPMorgan Chase, a very big bank, plans to use more smart computer power.
[Aria] 在银行界，摩根大通，一家非常大的银行，计划使用更多的智能计算机能力。

[Andrew] Yes, they plan to use AI agents. These are like smart computer helpers. They will help the bank do its work.
[Andrew] 是的，他们计划使用AI代理。这些就像智能计算机助手。它们将帮助银行完成工作。

[Aria] This means the bank can work faster. It can help its customers better. It can make money moves more safe.
[Aria] 这意味着银行可以更快地工作。它可以更好地帮助客户。它可以使资金流动更安全。

[Andrew] AI is changing many parts of our world. Even big banks are using it. It is a tool to make work better and faster.
[Andrew] AI正在改变我们世界的许多部分。即使是大银行也在使用它。它是一种使工作更好、更快进行的工具。

[Aria] Now, let us look at some news from China. China has a very big plan for smart computer power.
[Aria] 现在，让我们看看来自中国的一些新闻。中国有一个非常大的智能计算机能力计划。

[Andrew] Yes, China plans to put much money into this. About $295 billion. This is a very big amount of money.
[Andrew] 是的，中国计划投入大量资金。大约2950亿美元。这是一个非常大的金额。

[Aria] They want to build many "data centers." These are big buildings. They hold many computers. These computers store much information. They do much work.
[Aria] 他们想建造许多“数据中心”。这些是大型建筑。它们容纳许多计算机。这些计算机存储大量信息。它们做很多工作。

[Andrew] This plan is to help China grow its own smart computer power. They want to make their own "chips." Chips are the small brains inside computers.
[Andrew] 这个计划是为了帮助中国发展自己的智能计算机能力。他们想制造自己的“芯片”。芯片是计算机内部的小大脑。

[Aria] This means China wants to be strong in this area. They do not want to depend on other countries for these chips. They want to make their own.
[Aria] 这意味着中国想在这个领域变得强大。他们不想依赖其他国家提供这些芯片。他们想自己制造。

[Andrew] It is a big step for China. They want to be at the front of smart computer power. They want to make their own future.
[Andrew] 这是中国的一大步。他们想走在智能计算机能力的前沿。他们想创造自己的未来。

[Aria] But there is also some other news from China. Car sales went down in May.
[Aria] 但中国还有一些其他新闻。5月份汽车销量下降了。

[Andrew] Yes, car sales fell by 22.3 percent. This means many fewer cars were sold.
[Andrew] 是的，汽车销量下降了22.3%。这意味着售出的汽车数量大大减少了。

[Aria] This shows that people in China are buying less. We call this "domestic demand." When demand weakens, it means people are not spending as much money.
[Aria] 这表明中国人民购买力下降。我们称之为“国内需求”。当需求减弱时，意味着人们没有花那么多钱。

[Andrew] This can be a sign. It can show that the money system is slowing down. When people buy less, companies make less money. This can mean less work for people.
[Andrew] 这可能是一个迹象。它可能表明经济体系正在放缓。当人们购买减少时，公司赚的钱就减少了。这可能意味着人们的工作机会减少。

[Aria] It is a point to watch. The health of a country's money system is important. Car sales can tell us much about it.
[Aria] 这是一个值得关注的重点。一个国家经济体系的健康状况很重要。汽车销量可以告诉我们很多信息。

[Andrew] Now, let us turn to some world events. There is sad news from the Middle East.
[Andrew] 现在，让我们转向一些世界事件。中东传来悲伤的消息。

[Aria] The Israeli military has told people to leave a city in Lebanon. The city is called Tyre.
[Aria] 以色列军方已告知黎巴嫩一座城市的人们撤离。这座城市名为提尔。

[Andrew] This order means people must leave their homes. It is a very hard thing for families. They must go to a safe place.
[Andrew] 这项命令意味着人们必须离开家园。这对家庭来说是非常艰难的事情。他们必须去一个安全的地方。

[Aria] This includes a part of Tyre where Christian people live. It shows that the danger is wide.
[Aria] 这包括提尔城中基督徒居住的一个区域。这表明危险范围很广。

[Andrew] This is part of a bigger fight. There has been much fighting between Israel and groups in Lebanon.
[Andrew] 这是更大冲突的一部分。以色列和黎巴嫩境内的团体之间发生了许多战斗。

[Aria] It is a sad picture. People are leaving their homes because of war. We hope for peace for them.
[Aria] 这是一幅悲伤的画面。人们因为战争而离开家园。我们希望他们能获得和平。

[Andrew] In other news, there was a very bad act in Belfast. Belfast is a city in Northern Ireland.
[Andrew] 另外一则新闻，贝尔法斯特发生了一起非常恶劣的事件。贝尔法斯特是北爱尔兰的一座城市。

[Aria] Police say a man was arrested. This was after a "brutal" stabbing. A stabbing is a violent act with a knife.
[Aria] 警方称一名男子被捕。这是在一次“残忍”的刺伤事件之后。刺伤是用刀进行的暴力行为。

[Andrew] This was a very sad event. It made many people feel bad. It made people feel fear.
[Andrew] 这是一个非常悲伤的事件。它让许多人感到难过。它让人们感到恐惧。

[Aria] Leaders in Northern Ireland have talked about this. They want peace. They want people to be safe.
[Aria] 北爱尔兰的领导人已经谈论了这件事。他们想要和平。他们希望人们安全。

[Andrew] It is a reminder that even in places that seem quiet, bad things can happen. Police are working to keep people safe.
[Andrew] 这提醒我们，即使在看似平静的地方，也可能发生不好的事情。警方正在努力保护人们的安全。

[Aria] And on a wider note, a report says that fights and wars are growing all over the world.
[Aria] 另外，一份报告指出，世界各地的冲突和战争正在增加。

[Andrew] Yes, the report says that conflicts are at the highest level since World War Two. World War Two was a very big war many years ago.
[Andrew] 是的，报告称冲突达到了二战以来的最高水平。二战是许多年前一场非常大的战争。

[Aria] This means there are more fights between groups and countries now. More places have war.
[Aria] 这意味着现在团体和国家之间有更多的冲突。更多地方有战争。

[Andrew] This is a sad fact. It means more people are in danger. More people are losing their homes. More people are suffering.
[Andrew] 这是一个悲伤的事实。这意味着更多的人处于危险之中。更多的人失去家园。更多的人正在受苦。

[Aria] We need to think about why this is happening. And what can be done to bring peace.
[Aria] 我们需要思考为什么会发生这种情况。以及可以做些什么来带来和平。

[Andrew] Finally, some news about Israel and Iran. After many attacks, they seem to be stopping.
[Andrew] 最后，一些关于以色列和伊朗的新闻。在多次袭击之后，他们似乎正在停止。

[Aria] Yes, there were many attacks between these two countries. It was a very tense time.
[Aria] 是的，这两个国家之间发生了多次袭击。那是一个非常紧张的时期。

[Andrew] But now, they have sent signals. They say they will stop the attacks for now.
[Andrew] 但现在，他们发出了信号。他们说他们暂时会停止袭击。

[Aria] This is a small hope for peace. It means the fighting may not grow bigger.
[Aria] 这是和平的一线希望。这意味着战斗可能不会扩大。

[Andrew] But the feeling is still tight. The problems between them are still there. We hope this stop will last. We hope it will lead to true peace.
[Andrew] 但气氛仍然紧张。他们之间的问题仍然存在。我们希望这次停止能够持续。我们希望它能带来真正的和平。

[Aria] That is all our news for today. We hope this helped you learn English. And understand the world a little better.
[Aria] 这就是我们今天的所有新闻。我们希望这能帮助您学习英语。并更好地了解这个世界。

[Andrew] Thank you for being with us. We will be here again tomorrow with more news.
[Andrew] 感谢您的收听。明天我们还会在这里带来更多新闻。

[Aria] Good night, everyone.
[Aria] 大家晚安。

[Andrew] Good night.
[Andrew] 晚安。

# Morning News Podcast: Simple English for Earthly Events
# 晨间新闻播客：用简单英语聊全球大事

Good morning, friends. Welcome to our morning news podcast. This is a special talk for people who are learning the English language.
大家早上好，朋友们。欢迎收听我们的晨间新闻播客。这是一档专为英语学习者设计的特别节目。

I am your teacher and your guide this day. We will talk about the news of the earth. We will use simple words. We will use short sentences.
我是你们今天的老师和向导。我们将聊聊地球上发生的新闻。我们会使用简单的单词和简短的句子。

But we will talk about many important things. We will talk about new machines, about money, about countries, and about the fights in the earth.
但我们将讨论许多重要的事情。我们会谈到新机器、金钱、国家以及世界上的冲突。

This will help you get the sense of English and learn about the earth at the same time. Let us start with our first story.
这将帮助你在了解世界的同时，培养英语语感。让我们从第一个故事开始吧。

## Segment 1: Technology News (Apple WWDC 2026)
## 第一板块：科技新闻（苹果 WWDC 2026）

Our first story is about the company Apple. Apple is a very big company. They make the iPhone, the iPad, and the Mac. Every year, they have a great meeting.
我们的第一个故事是关于苹果公司的。苹果是一家非常大的公司。他们制造 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac。每年，他们都会举办一次盛大的会议。

The name of this meeting is WWDC. It is a meeting for the builders of systems. In the year 2026, Apple made a great statement at this meeting.
这个会议的名字叫 WWDC（全球开发者大会）。这是一个系统构建者的会议。在 2026 年，苹果在这次会议上发表了重大声明。

They talked about Siri. Siri is the voice inside your iPhone. You talk to Siri, and Siri helps you. But for a long time, Siri was not very wise.
他们谈到了 Siri。Siri 是你 iPhone 里的声音。你对 Siri 说话，Siri 就会帮助你。但在很长一段时间里，Siri 并不是很聪明。

Siri did not get the sense of complex questions. Now, Apple says they are making Siri much better. They are using a "made mind" or AI.
Siri 无法理解复杂的问题。现在，苹果表示他们正在让 Siri 变得更好。他们正在使用“人造大脑”或人工智能（AI）。

Let us make a deep look into the history of Siri. Siri was first made by a small group of people. Apple got this small company in the year 2010.
让我们深入了解一下 Siri 的历史。Siri 最初是由一小群人制作的。苹果公司在 2010 年收购了这家小公司。

At that time, Siri was a great wonder. No other pocket machine had a voice that was able to talk back to you. But as the years went by, Siri did not get much better.
在那个时候，Siri 是一个伟大的奇迹。没有其他口袋机器拥有能够对你回话的声音。但随着时间流逝，Siri 并没有变得更好。

Why? Because Siri was built on old rules. If you said "A", Siri said "B". If you said something strange, Siri was not able to get the sense of it. It would only say, "I am not able to help with that."
为什么？因为 Siri 是建立在旧规则之上的。如果你说“A”，Siri 就会说“B”。如果你说了一些奇怪的话，Siri 就无法理解它的意思。它只会说：“我无法为此提供帮助。”

But now, we have a new kind of "made mind". This new mind is able to make new words and get the sense of human feelings. It does not just follow old rules.
但现在，我们有了一种新型的“人造大脑”。这种新的心智能够创造新词并理解人类的情感。它不仅仅遵循旧的规则。

It is able to learn from millions of books and pages on the net. This is why Apple has to change Siri. If they do not, people will not have a desire to get iPhones anymore. They will get other machines that have better minds inside.
它能够从网络上的数百万本书籍和网页中学习。这就是为什么苹果必须改变 Siri。如果他们不这样做，人们将不再渴望购买 iPhone。他们会去买其他内部拥有更好大脑的机器。

To make Siri wise, Apple is joining with other big companies. They are working with Google and Nvidia. Google is a great company of the net. Nvidia makes very strong brain chips for machines.
为了让 Siri 变得聪明，苹果正在与其他大公司合作。他们正在与谷歌和英伟达合作。谷歌是网络巨头。英伟达为机器制造非常强大的大脑芯片。

Why is Apple joining with them? Because making a wise "made mind" needs a very great amount of power. It needs many machines working together. Apple is not able to do all of this by itself.
为什么苹果要加入他们？因为制造一个聪明的“人造大脑”需要极大的算力。它需要许多机器协同工作。苹果无法独自完成这一切。

But some people who put money in Apple were not happy. They had a desire for Apple to do everything by itself. They had a desire for a bigger surprise.
但是一些把钱投给苹果的人（投资者）并不高兴。他们希望苹果能独自完成所有事情。他们渴望更大的惊喜。

Because of this, the price of Apple shares went down on the market. When people are not surprised, they give their parts of the company to others for money. This makes the price go down.
正因为如此，苹果的股票价格在市场上流失了。当人们没有感到惊喜时，他们就会把公司的股份给别人以换取金钱（卖出）。这导致价格下跌。

But this is normal for the market. In the future, when people use the new Siri, the price may go up again.
但这对市场来说是正常的。未来，当人们开始使用新的 Siri 时，价格可能会再次上涨。

Apple also talked about the new system for the iPhone. The name of this system is iOS 27. It has some very interesting new parts.
苹果还谈到了 iPhone 的新系统。这个系统的名字是 iOS 27。它有一些非常有趣的新部分。

First, you are now able to use one phone number on two iPhones. This is very good for people who have one iPhone for work and one iPhone for play.
首先，你现在可以在两部 iPhone 上使用同一个电话号码。这对于那些一部 iPhone 用于工作、另一部用于娱乐的人来说非常方便。

Before this, you had to have two different numbers. Now, you are able to let both machines use the same number.
在此之前，你必须拥有两个不同的号码。现在，你可以让两台机器使用同一个号码。

Second, you are able to change the loudness of your morning bell separate from other sounds. This is a simple thing, but it is very important.
其次，你可以单独改变早晨闹钟的音量，而不影响其他声音。这是一件简单却非常重要的事情。

At some times, you have a desire for your morning bell to be very loud so you wake up. But you have a desire for the sound of your talking instrument to be quiet. In the old system, they were the same. Now, they are separate.
有时，你希望早晨的闹钟非常响，以便把你叫醒。但你希望通话仪器的声音保持安静。在旧系统中，它们是一样的。现在，它们分开了。

Third, the system for sending sound and pictures from one machine to another, which is named AirPlay, is now much more quick.
第三，用于将声音和画面从一台机器发送到另一台机器的系统（名为 AirPlay）现在速度快得多。

And there is good news for people who have old iPhones. Apple says that iOS 27 will work on many older machines. You do not have to get a new iPhone to get the new system.
对于拥有旧 iPhone 的人来说，还有一个好消息。苹果表示，iOS 27 将在许多旧机器上运行。你不需要为了获得新系统而购买新 iPhone。

This is good for your pocket, and it is good for the earth because we make less waste.
这对你的钱包有好处，对地球也有好处，因为我们产生的垃圾变少了。

Now let us talk about the big brain machines, the Macs. Apple has a new system for the Mac. The name of this system is macOS 27 Golden Gate.
现在让我们谈谈大脑袋机器——Mac。苹果为 Mac 推出了新系统。这个系统的名字是 macOS 27 Golden Gate。

But there is a very big change here. This new system will only work on Macs that have Apple's own brain chips. These chips are named Apple Silicon.
但这里有一个非常大的变化。这个新系统将只能在拥有苹果自己大脑芯片的 Mac 上运行。这些芯片被称为 Apple Silicon。

Let us talk about the history of Apple and Intel. In the year 2005, the leader of Apple, Steve Jobs, made a great statement. He said Apple would start using Intel chips in all Mac machines.
让我们谈谈苹果和英特尔的历史。在 2005 年，苹果的领导者史蒂夫·乔布斯发表了一项重大声明。他说苹果将开始在所有 Mac 机器中使用英特尔芯片。

Before that, Macs used different chips that were slow and hot. The move to Intel was a great success. It made Macs very popular. For fifteen years, Apple and Intel worked together as close friends.
在那之前，Mac 使用的是其他又慢又热的芯片。转向英特尔取得了巨大的成功。它让 Mac 变得非常流行。十五年来，苹果和英特尔作为亲密朋友并肩工作。

But then, Apple saw that Intel was not making its chips better fast enough. The chips were still hot and used too much power. So, Apple made the decision to make its own chips.
但后来，苹果发现英特尔提升芯片速度的步伐不够快。芯片依然发热严重且耗电量大。因此，苹果决定制造自己的芯片。

In the year 2020, they put out the first Mac with Apple's own chip. It was a great surprise. The new machines were very quick and the battery lasted for a very long time.
在 2020 年，他们推出了第一款搭载苹果自身芯片的 Mac。这是一个巨大的惊喜。新机器速度极快，电池续航时间也非常长。

Now, six years later, Apple is saying goodbye to Intel completely. This is the end of an era.
现在，六年过去了，苹果要彻底对英特尔说再见了。这是一个时代的终结。

If you have an older Mac with an Intel chip, you are not able to put macOS 27 Golden Gate on it. This is a sad event for some people who have old machines.
如果你有一台搭载英特尔芯片的旧 Mac，你将无法在上面安装 macOS 27 Golden Gate。对于一些拥有旧机器的人来说，这是一件令人难过的事情。

But Apple says it is necessary. The new "made mind" systems need the special power of Apple Silicon. The old Intel chips are not strong enough. This is how science moves forward. Old things have to give way to new things.
但苹果表示这是必要的。新的“人造大脑”系统需要 Apple Silicon 的特殊力量。旧的英特尔芯片不够强大。这就是科学进步的方式。旧事物必须让位于新事物。

Apple also has a new system for its watch. The name is watchOS 27.
苹果还为其手表推出了新系统。名字是 watchOS 27。

Like the iPhone and the Mac, the watch will now have Siri with "made mind". You are able to talk to your watch, and it will give you wise answers.
就像 iPhone 和 Mac 一样，手表现在也将拥有配备“人造大脑”的 Siri。你可以对手表说话，它会给你聪明的回答。

The watch will also have a new way to show your small systems. It is a changing square system, or a dynamic grid. It makes it more simple to see and touch your tools on the small glass face.
手表还将有一种展示你小程序的新方式。这是一个不断变化的方形系统，即动态网格。它让你在小玻璃面上查看和触摸工具变得更加简单。

But there is a catch. To get this new Siri on your watch, you may need to get a new Apple Watch. The old watches do not have the strong brain chips inside.
但这里有一个限制。为了在手表上获得这个新的 Siri，你可能需要买一个新苹果手表。旧手表内部没有强大的大脑芯片。

Apple is stopping support for a long list of older watches. This is the same story as the Mac. New science needs new solid parts.
苹果正在停止对一大批旧款手表的支持。这和 Mac 的情况一模一样。新的科学需要新的硬件支持。

---

## Segment 2: Business & Finance News (OpenAI & SpaceX IPOs)
## 第二板块：商业与金融新闻（OpenAI 与 SpaceX 的 IPO）

Now we move to our second segment. This is about business and money.
现在我们进入第二板块。这是关于商业和金钱的。

Our first story here is about OpenAI. OpenAI is the company that made ChatGPT. ChatGPT is a very famous machine that is able to talk like a person. It has changed how we make thoughts about the future.
我们的第一个故事是关于 OpenAI 的。OpenAI 是制造 ChatGPT 的公司。ChatGPT 是一款非常著名的、能够像人一样说话的机器。它改变了我们对未来的思考方式。

Now, OpenAI has sent a secret request to the government. They have a desire to do an IPO. What is an IPO? It is an Initial Public Offering. In simple words, it means the company will give its parts to all people on the market for money.
现在，OpenAI 已经向政府提交了一份秘密申请。他们渴望进行 IPO。什么是 IPO？它是首次公开募股。简单来说，这意味着公司将在市场上向所有人出售其股份以换取资金。

Let us look at the history of OpenAI. This company started in the year 2015. At the start, it was a non-profit organization. This means they did not have a desire to make money.
让我们来看看 OpenAI 的历史。这家公司成立于 2015 年。刚开始时，它是一个非营利组织。这意味着他们并不渴望赚钱。

Their only purpose was to make "made mind" that would help all people on the earth. Elon Musk was one of the people who gave money to start it.
他们唯一的目的是制造能够帮助地球上所有人的“人造大脑”。埃隆·马斯克是出资启动该项目的人之一。

But after some years, the builders saw that making "made mind" was too expensive. They needed billions of dollars to get the machines and pay the experts.
但几年后，建造者们发现制造“人造大脑”太贵了。他们需要数十亿美元来购买机器并支付专家费用。

A non-profit organization is not able to get that much money. So, they changed the company. They made a new part of the company that was able to make profit.
一个非营利组织是无法获得那么多资金的。所以，他们改变了公司。他们成立了公司中能够盈利的新部门。

This made some of the first founders, like Elon Musk, very angry. They said OpenAI was not true to its first promise.
这让包括埃隆·马斯克在内的一些最初的创始人非常生气。他们说 OpenAI 违背了最初的承诺。

Now, by doing an IPO, OpenAI is becoming a fully public company. It is a long way from its start as a quiet group of science lovers.
现在，通过进行 IPO，OpenAI 正在成为一家完全公开的上市公司。这距离它最初作为一个安静的科学爱好者团体已经走了很长一段路。

Before this, only a few rich people and big companies were able to put money into OpenAI. Now, anyone is able to get a part of the company.
在此之前，只有少数富人和大公司能够把钱投给 OpenAI。现在，任何人都可以获得公司的一部分股份。

Why is OpenAI doing this in secret? In the United States, companies are able to send their papers to the government quietly first. This lets them make adjustments before all people see the papers.
为什么 OpenAI 要秘密进行这件事？在美国，公司可以先悄悄地向政府提交文件。这让他们可以在所有人看到文件之前进行调整。

OpenAI needs a very great amount of money. Why? Because training "made mind" systems is very expensive. They have to get thousands of strong chips from Nvidia.
OpenAI 需要极大量的资金。为什么？因为训练“人造大脑”系统非常昂贵。他们必须从英伟达购买成千上万的强大芯片。

They have to make payment for much electric power. By giving parts of the company to the public for money, they are able to get the money they need to fight against other big companies like Google.
他们必须支付大量的电费。通过向公众出售公司股份，他们能够获得所需的资金，以对抗谷歌等其他大公司。

Another very big company is also getting ready for an IPO. This is SpaceX.
另一家非常大的公司也正在准备 IPO。这就是 SpaceX。

SpaceX is the rocket company of Elon Musk. They make vessels that fly to the stars. They send sky instruments into orbit. They also have Starlink, which gives net connection to the whole earth from the sky.
SpaceX 是埃隆·马斯克的火箭公司。他们制造飞向星空的飞船。他们将天空仪器送入轨道。他们还拥有 Starlink（星链），从空中为整个地球提供网络连接。

Let us look at the history of SpaceX. Elon Musk started SpaceX in the year 2002. At that time, almost everyone said he was foolish.
